_doc: PRE-REGISTERED acceptance for the tapped-line timer campaign (Q1 + N-spread half of Q3 of the hybrid pulse-width-generator architecture). Written BEFORE any timer deck was run. Anchors used, not re-derived: tg15p TRUE-ZCS row (swsweep/RESULTS_SWEEP.json): E_hop_open 8.3828 fJ, true zero 266.76 ps, VBEND 0.6759, VBPK 0.7374, IZ -0.38 uA on IPK 194.4 uA, cells 1.695 fJ; ring-robust tg60 anchor 10.69 fJ @ 291.34 ps; mistiming sensitivity +50 ps late -> -0.9% E_hop / -2.2% VBEND (MEASURED, tg15p); inverter anchor sg13g2_inv_1 44-stage FO1 line at 1.2V: 44.7 ps/stage, ~6.3 fJ/inv/traversal (async_power_anchor); N=8 zero data-spread 61.6 ps / 16.9% at dV=0.8 (qal_bankN_zcs.json); ideal-drive tg15p gate energy EGT_D = 3.56 fJ/hop (recomputed from committed sw_tg15p_z.cir.mt0 -- the uncosted timer budget's lower bound).

instrument_gates.G0_postprocessing: My prn/mt0 pipeline must reproduce the committed tg15p_zcs row from its own artifacts before any new deck: E_hop_open 8.3828 fJ and cells_burn 1.6955 fJ to 4 decimals. STATUS: PASSED before this file was written (8.382817 / 1.695475).
instrument_gates.G1_line_cal: 24-stage FO1 sg13g2_inv_1 chain at 1.2V must give per-stage delay within +/-15% of the 42-45 ps anchor band (i.e. 35.7-51.7 ps). The 1.5V number is then the design point, reported as measured; no acceptance band (the anchor was never taken at 1.5V).
instrument_gates.G2_hop_repro: The full-hop deck is a TEXT PATCH of the committed swsweep/sw_tg15p_z.cir (drives replaced, everything else byte-identical). The patch script must show the only removed lines are VGT/VGTP/VPK sources and the three drive integrator B-source expressions, and the only additions are the timer netlist, timer integrators, and print columns.

acceptance.A_tuned_width: After at most one integer-stage choice plus two CTRIM iterations, the effective conduction window (gt 50% rise to gt 50% fall) lands within +/-15 ps of a target picked from the zero; equivalently |I(LT)| at the effective cut is <= 10% of IPK. If the discrete line cannot land inside that band the residual is the finding, reported with its energy cost via the measured -0.9%/50ps sensitivity.
acceptance.B_real_drive_hop: Completeness per the swsweep amendment, re-anchored to the tg15p_zcs row: VBEND within 2% of 0.6759 AND bank A actually drained at the open (V(bka) at open <= 0.0978 + 0.05). E_hop_open reported against 8.3828 fJ; the tg15p-vs-tg60 win (-21.6% vs the 10.69 ring-robust anchor) either survives real edges or its loss is the finding.
acceptance.C_edge_park: Park behavior with real ~15-25 ps edges arriving ~2 gate delays after gtp: report post-open V(sw) ring amplitude/damping and bank-B disturbance (min/max after open) side by side with the ideal-drive z-run prn. No pass band pre-set: this has never been measured; the comparison is the deliverable.
acceptance.D_tracking: Corner = temperature (0C and 85C vs 27C), applied to BOTH line and hop. Tracking ratio r = (dWidth/Width)/(dZero/Zero). PRE-STATED EXPECTATION (falsifiable): the hop zero is LC-dominated (ideal L, weak T dependence through R_on and gate C) while the line is transistor-RC (strong T dependence), so I expect r > 1 -- the naive replica principle should FAIL in magnitude across temperature; the sign decides whether hot drift is benign (late-open direction) or malign (early-open, interrupted current). Whatever r is measured sets the calibration cadence; a negative or >>1 result is first-class.
acceptance.E_n_spread: Zero-cross time vs data at N=8/32/128 (parallel-copy scaling of the committed N=8 zcs config: dV=0.8, L8=400nH, RS8=10, WSW8=20/40 TG per copy, CA8=35.0025 fF; TON=10 ps uniformly, offset vs the committed 2 ps N=8 rows measured and reported). 1/sqrt(N) VERDICT RULE: fit sigma_t(random words) ~ N^p; p in [-0.65,-0.35] = holds; else refuted. PRE-STATED: by the same scale-invariance argument as the rail measurement, t_zcs should be a function of a=k/N alone, so sigma over random words falls ~1/sqrt(N) while the FULL-SCALE (k=0 vs k=N) spread stays ~constant -- if so, the shared-timer budget must either charge the full-scale spread as worst-case or the architecture must justify random-data statistics. Placement independence at fixed k is checked with 3 permutations at k=N/2.

config_frozen.hop: tg15p on the committed iso-current point: dV=1.0, L=277.8 nH, RS=10, CA=35.979 fF, 8 metered cells, VGH=1.5
config_frozen.timer_cells: sg13g2 stdcells (PDK spice + sg13lv_compat shim): line/nd/pk-chain inv_1, input si0=inv_1 si1=inv_2, pulse NAND=nand2_2, gt driver inv_4 (load 5um nMOS gate ~7.7 fF), gtp branch inv_2->inv_8 (load 10um pMOS ~15.4 fF), pk branch 6 stages (even-N) or 5 (odd-N) ending inv_2 (load 1um park gate ~1.5 fF), all at VDD=1.5V (must produce 1.5V gate swings)
config_frozen.metering: four separate timer supplies: VTL line+input, VTG nd+NAND+gt driver, VTP gtp branch, VTK pk branch; trigger energy metered separately as -V(strig)*I(VST); everything integrated with the harness's 1F-integrator instrument
config_frozen.ordering_guard: pk must rise AFTER gt falls and after gtp rises (the swsweep v1 park failure: park-before-open shorts bank A through L); enforced structurally by tapping pk 2 stages past gtp
